images.prompt: A drafting compass and a pair of dividers resting on a dark drafting surface beside a sheet of paper seen at such a grazing angle that nothing written on it could be visible, and it is blank and unmarked. No ruler and no measuring scale in frame. Cream light along the polished instruments. The single red element is one red pivot screw on the compass. Deep dark navy dominates every surface and every background plane — never blue, never cyan, no teal anywhere. Soft cream (#F4EFE3) is the only highlight. Exactly one red element in the entire image, nothing else is red. Absolutely no text, no letterforms, no numerals, no signage, no logos, no vendor marks on any faceplate or panel. No tick-mark numerals. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame. Quiet, photographic, shallow depth of field.
images.qa: Approved, first roll. Compass and dividers, blank sheet, no ruler in frame — dropping the scale rule avoided the tick-mark-numeral failure mode.
